title: Billing Desk Note: Paying Charges from Harborline Account Credit
content:
# Paying charges from account credit

## The rule the desk applies

Account credit may pay for a charge only while the account status is active or recovery hold. Credit pays a charge only when the credit balance covers the whole charge, since partial application of credit is not allowed, and otherwise the charge goes to the default card in full. Every auto-renew charge in any category tries credit first, while for a purchase made in conversation credit is used only when the customer chooses it. Spending consumes refund, service and goodwill credit before deposited credit, and deposited credit oldest deposit first. Each paid charge is recorded once, with the reference number of the product charge it paid.

| Tier | Credit tried before the default card for every auto-renew charge | Purchase paid partly from credit and partly from a card |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline Personal Account | Yes (true) | Not allowed (false) |
| Harborline Business Account | Yes (true) | Not allowed (false) |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | Yes (true) | Not allowed (false) |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | Yes (true) | Not allowed (false) |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | Yes (true) | Not allowed (false) |
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | Yes (true) | Not allowed (false) |

## Condition, judgement, result

| Account status | Balance against the charge | Result |
|---|---|---|
| active or recovery hold | covers the whole charge | credit pays the charge (for an auto-renew charge automatically; for a purchase in conversation only if the customer chooses credit) |
| active or recovery hold | short of the whole charge | the charge goes to the default card in full; no credit is used |
| locked, closed or unverified | any | credit does not pay the charge |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

A balance of $61.15 meets an auto-renew charge of $63.90. The balance does not cover the whole charge, so the full $63.90 goes to the default card and the $61.15 stays on the account. Had the balance been $63.90 or more, credit would have paid the whole charge.

## Order of consumption (hypothetical)

An account holds $14.00 of goodwill credit, a $50.00 deposit from March and a $50.00 deposit from May. A $70.00 charge paid from credit uses the $14.00 goodwill credit first, then $50.00 of the March deposit, then $6.00 of the May deposit.

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts*
